title: Definitions underlying adic stratified perfectness
statement:
On a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], a commutative ring $A$ and an ideal $I$, the module
`Sheaf.Paper.AdicStratifiedPerfect` supplies the coefficient and residue definitions used by
adic constructibility.  On the pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site],
`sfbFixedScalarRestriction` restricts modules over the constant ring to fixed scalar module
sheaves, and `sfbEtaleTensorDegreeZero` is the termwise tensor of an étale cochain complex
with a degree-zero module sheaf.  `sfbResidueComplex` is the fixed-scalar residue reduction
of an object of the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] along
the canonical exponent-one quotient; `sfbModelRings` is the corresponding transport to an
equivalent small site.  `IsSfbAdicComplete` is local derived completeness for the kernel of
that quotient in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete].
`IsSfbAdicConstructible` is the conjunction of this completeness with a bounded complex on
the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] having constructible cohomology, a residue
isomorphism along the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and the
finite Tor-amplitude condition formed with the relative derived tensor of
[sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom].  The constructible strata and finite coefficient models
use [def-constructible-stratification] and [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].
